Jain previously worked at Cantor Fitzgerald, where he built its technology investment banking group. This hiring coincides with HSBC's strategy to focus on financing areas with greater competitive strength. The bank aims to expand its market share in Asia and the Middle East's tech sectors.

banking-economy.title: Andhra Pradesh commercial tax collections rise 18 pc to Rs 30,436 cr in H1
banking-economy.summary: Andhra Pradesh’s commercial tax collections rose 18% year-on-year to Rs 30,435.98 crore during April-September 2026, with September recording the highest monthly collection so far. Net GST collections increased 18% to Rs 19,635.49 crore in the first half of FY 2026-27, while September net GST rose 14.10%. The state attributed the growth to stronger compliance, enforcement, economic activity and technology-led tax monitoring.
